title: Holds on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Rule.** An active Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account is placed on hold, with the hold reason "violation points threshold", when its active violation points reach the level's hold threshold, and at once, with the hold reason "incident investigation", when a zero-tolerance violation is recorded, before the investigation concludes. A hold is released only while the account is on hold and only when the review found no deactivation cause. A hold must end within the level's hold limit counted from the hold start date. Batches accepted before the hold are paid where the level pays them; where the level requires the in-app refresher after a hold, the shopper completes it before new batches are offered.

## Figures by level

| Level | Hold threshold (active points at or above) | Hold must end within (days of the hold start date) | Batches accepted before the hold paid | Refresher before new batches |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | 7 | 14 | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Shopper | 7 | 14 | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 9 | 14 | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 9 | 10 | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 11 | 10 | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 13 | 7 | Yes | No |

## How a hold begins and ends

- **Placed for points:** the account is active and its active points reach the threshold (the threshold figure itself is enough).
- **Placed for an incident:** a zero-tolerance violation is recorded; the hold does not wait for the investigation's outcome.
- **Released:** the account's status record shows it on hold, and the review found no deactivation cause. The hold then ends and batch access returns.
- **Ended otherwise:** a review that upholds a deactivation cause ends the hold in deactivation.
- **Time limit:** whichever way it ends, the hold ends within the level's limit from the hold start date.

## Points of judgement

- *A Full-Service Shopper Gold account reaches 9 active points.* It is placed on hold; 8 points would not have been enough.
- *A Full-Service Shopper Diamond account's hold is released.* No refresher is required at Diamond; at every other level the refresher is completed before new batches are offered.
